blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) continued its search and rescue operations on Saturday for the eight missing passengers of the ill-fated M/V June Aster in the waters and shoreline of Calanhayaun Island in Barangay Tara, Coron, Palawan. Personnel from the Coast Guard District Palawan Disaster Response Group and Special Operations Group, along with the crew of BRP Suluan (MRRV-4406) and Marine Environmental Protection-Northeastern Palawan, conducted maritime and foot patrols and shoreline monitoring around the area where the vessel sank. The PCG also deployed HSRB-011 and rubber boats for maritime patrol and search operations, while drones were used to conduct […]...
